jobs.description:
In this Senior Partner Manager role, you’ll be…

• 
Accountable for driving regional growth across the Nordic market by facilitating end-to-end sales cycles (from lead to closed-won) in close collaboration with an enterprise-grade partner ecosystem and an internal team of experienced Account Executives.

• 
A strategic partner builder and commercial lighthouse, establishing executive-level relationships with directors at top audit firms, consultancies, and legal specialists, alongside leading solution-oriented direct selling.

• 
Driving revenue impact through dual channels, taking ownership of direct pipeline while co-designing structured partner motions (onboarding, enablement, deal support) to hit both direct and partner-sourced targets.

• 
Manage large partner-related projects, in close collaboration with internal product experts, Marketing, Sales Enablement and Revenue Operations.

• 
A trusted domain advisor and cross-functional collaborator, enabling partners and prospects on complex frameworks (NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, GDPR) while staying closely aligned with the regional strategies in coordination with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Leadership.

Who is the Partner Management Team?

The Partner Management Team is instrumental in strengthening Formalize’s partner-led go-to-market strategy as we build the leading European platform for Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC). Focused on the Nordic region, we build, structure, and scale enterprise-grade ecosystems across audit firms, advisory consultancies, legal specialists, and boutique partners. We don't do transactional channel management - we drive strategic, revenue-relevant alignment. By connecting partner- and director-level stakeholders externally with our internal Sales, Product, and Leadership teams, we build pipeline, deep credibility, and long-term value in an increasingly complex market of regulations, standards and resilience best practices.

What you’ll bring:

• 
Proven expertise in strategic partnerships, alliances, or enterprise business development, ideally within B2B SaaS, advisory, compliance, cybersecurity or regulated industries.

• 
Proven experience collaborating with enterprise consulting, legal advisory or audit partners (experience with Big-4 or equivalent strongly preferred).

• 
Deep understanding of compliance, risk, audit, and regulatory buying centers, or a proven ability to quickly adapt on knowledge gaps.

• 
Commercial mindset with proven experience owning or materially influencing revenue outcomes (previous direct sales experience, e.g., as an AE, is a big plus).

• 
Professional fluency in Swedish, Norwegian or Danish, and the ability to work in an English-first team, to communicate value and negotiate seamlessly with customers and colleagues.

• 
Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to act as a trusted advisor when engaging with senior partner- and director-level decision-makers.

• 
Experience using a SaaS-typical tech stack of Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, HubSpot is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

We offer you:

• 
Our starting annual base salary ranges from DKK 44,500 to DKK 51,250 based on experience and role progression, with total On-Target Earnings (OTE) reaching between DKK 52,353 and DKK 68,334.

• 
Continuous development through a clear and transparent career framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through biannual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• 
Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• 
An office-first culture in a central Copenhagen by Kødbyen, with benefits including lunch, health insurance, and social events.

• 
A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• 
A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• 
Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company connects over strategic achievements and projects.

Our recruitment process:

• 
Send your application and upload relevant information.

• 
30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team.

• 
60-minute online interview with our Hiring Manager.

• 
Complete a personality assessment and prepare a case presentation.

• 
60 minutes in-person case presentation interview with our Hiring Manager & other relevant stakeholders.

About Formalize:

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Munich, Madrid and Paris. Currently, we are a team of 200+ people from 30+ nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information in English through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Join Our Journey 🚀

We're on a mission to reinvent the VAT refund experience for travellers across Europe and we’re looking for enthusiastic Customer Support to help us get there. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, loves helping people, and wants hands-on experience in a growing fintech startup where ideas matter and your impact is visible from day one.

The Product

Pie Systems is revolutionising Tax-Free Shopping by providing a fully digitised end-to-end solution that eliminates the hassles of traditional processes. Our platform enables merchants to seamlessly facilitate VAT refunds while consumers can claim them easily through our app. The solution is free, offering consumers the market’s lowest fees and merchants the highest revenue share. With Pie Systems, there are no more paper forms, long queues, or excessive fees it's a straightforward and efficient experience for everyone.

Role Description

We are seeking a dedicated Customer Support professional to join our team in Copenhagen. This is a part-time, on-site role where you will play a key role in providing exceptional support to our customers. Daily tasks will include assisting customers with inquiries, troubleshooting technical issues, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, and working closely with internal teams to resolve escalations and provide feedback for continuous improvement. You will contribute to maintaining an exceptional user experience aligned with our goal to revolutionise Tax-Free Shopping.

What You'll Be Doing

Be the hero for travellers ✈️

You’ll be the friendly face behind the screen, helping tourists navigate their VAT refund:

• 
Validate and approve VAT refund claims.

• 
Support tourists via Intercom with clear, empathetic communication.

Support our merchants 🤝

Our merchant partners rely on us and you to keep the engine running smoothly:

• 
Packing and sending materials to merchants across Europe.

• 
Deliver materials physically to merchants in Copenhagen.

• 
Answer merchant questions and provide high-quality support.

• 
Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve and build better processes. Your feedback helps shape how we operate tomorrow. In a startup, your voice really matters.

What You Bring

• 
Fluent in English (must-have).

• 
French or German is a BIG plus, as well as Japanese and Chinese.

• 
Structured, systematic, and detail-oriented.

• 
Service-minded with a genuine passion for helping others.

• 
Strong communicator who enjoys solving problems.

• 
Results-driven and ready to take initiative.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

• 
Flexible hours (15–20/week) perfect alongside studies.

• 
Opportunity to work evenings and weekends if that suits your schedule.

• 
Work primarily from our Copenhagen office with occasional work-from-home days.

• 
Become part of a dynamic, ambitious fintech startup rethinking an entire industry.

• 
Real responsibility, real ownership, and immediate impact.

Compensation & Reporting

• 
160 DKK/hour

• 
You’ll report to Tim Vintervoll, Operations Manager Europe.

• 
Contract, terms and salary negotiation is handled by Nina Seidenfaden, General Manager Europe.

Does this sound like you?

If this sounds like you then we look very much forward to receiving your application!

Working at

Pie Systems

We are streamlining the process of tax free shopping for travellers, maximizing value and efficiency for both travellers and retailers alike. With our fully digitized end-to-end solution, retailers can facilitate, and travellers can claim VAT refunds at the touch of a button on their mobile device. Our team consists of Silicon Valley entrepreneurs, experienced leaders and talented people. Come join us!

Celare Quantum Communications is a Danish high-tech quantum technology company with a mission to radically improve cybersecurity and enable trusted global data sharing.

Our core product is a unique, cutting-edge technology born from years of university research called Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution (CV-QKD). This technology enables post-quantum secure key exchange for protecting sensitive data across critical infrastructure.

Celare partners with local and international governments, telecom operators, data centers, banks, defense ministries, and leading academic institutions. Over the past year our team has successfully launched commercial pilot deployments of our technology.

The Celare Team

We are a highly specialized and ambitious team of quantum engineers, serial entrepreneurs, laser, RF and electronics specialists, mathematicians, software engineers, and IC and FPGA designers.

Based in Copenhagen, we combine deep academic expertise with hands-on experience in launching complex, high-impact technology products.

The Role

In this role you will get a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of quantum technology development. You will be part of a small team of optical engineers responsible for optical development and test activities in the company. You will have a key role in our Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) development activities as a technical point of contact with our development partners.

As part of a small and agile organization, you will contribute across the full product lifecycle — from early architectural decisions and prototyping to production and large-scale deployment. You will work both in collaboration with our team and independently as a specialist, sharing knowledge across disciplines.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility and influence. It offers work with an international, multilingual and multicultural dynamic team with direct connection to academic research and bleeding-edge technologies.

The role is situated on site in our Copenhagen headquarters.

Responsibilities

• Leading and carrying out various PIC development activities

• Planning and execution of PIC test activities

• Development of optical subsystems for our CV-QKD and Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG) products

• Maintaining and extending the company’s optical laboratories

• Contributing specialist knowledge and collaborating to make the team excel at product development

Qualifications

• MSc or PhD in optics or similar

• 5+ years of work experience

• Experience with conducting experiments in fiber and/or free-space optics

• Experience with PIC technology and development

• Hands-on experience working with digital/analog electronics

• (Optional) Experience in using quantum theory

We Offer

This full-time position offers the opportunity to build and shape the future of quantum communication in collaboration with an experienced and dynamic team. We provide individual growth plans aligned with your personal preferences and motivation. We offer competitive compensation, depending on qualifications.

Contact

For more information or if you wish to apply, send an email to jobs@celare-quantum.com and mark the subject line: “Optical Engineer”.

Are you an experienced Team Leader – or a Senior Java Engineer ready to take the next step into people-leadership? As a Team Leader for our Java Core team, you will lead four software engineers and two student engineers while being an active part of the team yourself - we call it a hands-on Team Leader. You will stay close to technology and contribute to the solutions we build.

AI is changing software development rapidly, and you will play an important role in shaping how we use AI-assisted and agentic software development while ensuring that quality, security and strong engineering principles remain at the core.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

In this role, people-leadership and technical expertise go hand in hand. You will lead, support, and develop the Java Core team while also making hands-on technical contributions. You will actively participate in technical discussions, contribute to the development work, and help shape how we approach AI-assisted development across our Java environment.

You will also join a leadership community of 12 leaders across the department, giving you the opportunity to exchange perspectives, learn from experienced colleagues, and collaborate on both technical and people-related challenges.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A role with influence on both people, technology and the future direction of Java development at JYSK

• The opportunity to explore and shape our use of AI-assisted and agentic software development

• A strong leadership community where you can spar and develop together with experienced colleagues

• A culture with short decision-making processes and freedom with responsibility

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• Flexible working conditions and a workplace focused on maintaining a healthy work-life balance

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• 
Leading, supporting and developing the Java Core Team

• 
Providing technical guidance and contributing directly to the team’s engineering work, including design, development, and problem-solving

• 
Remaining actively involved in the team’s daily work while balancing hands-on contribution with leadership responsibilities

• 
Exploring how AI can support software development, improve engineering processes, and create new opportunities

• 
Supporting the thoughtful adaptation of AI while maintaining a strong focus on quality, security, and sound engineering practices

• 
Collaborating across different teams and working closely with the platform teams

• 
Implementing JYSK’s leadership principles, focusing on goal orientation and accountability.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has solid professional experience in software development and strong knowledge of Java technologies

• Is motivated by leading, supporting and developing software engineers

• Can combine technical leadership and people leadership while remaining an active part of the team

• Has strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoys collaborating across teams

• Has hands-on experience building and scaling an agentic Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and is curious about how AI can improve software development and engineering practices

• Ideally have experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development

• Takes responsibility, provides direction and creates an environment where colleagues can contribute and develop

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Liliana Hajek, Team Manager, Java Core & Order Orchestration at leh@jysk.com

Do you know what needs to be in place before a new power or gas market can go-live?

Can you combine commercial understanding with regulation, market design and project execution? As Senior Market Expansion Manager, you will coordinate new market entries and trading products from development through go-live, while helping improve the way these expand into new markets in NET.

The team

The Market Expansion team is responsible for expanding the footprint of Norlys Energy Trading (NET). The team works with colleagues across the company on new markets and trading products, coordinating the activities needed to prepare, implement, and launch them. The work changes from project to project, depending on the market, product, and stakeholders involved.

The role

You will lead projects related to new markets and trading products and coordinate the work needed to get them ready for go-live . This includes managing progress, aligning stakeholders, and handling the commercial, regulatory, and operational complexity that comes with entering new markets.

You will also be responsible for the lifecycle management of active markets and trading products and contribute to improving the Market Expansion  method.

Key responsibilities

Your work will cover both implementing new markets and trading products and expanding existing markets and trading products.

• Manage market and trading product development, implementation and go-live.

• Coordinate activities ahead of new market entries.

• Oversee the lifecycle of active markets and trading products.

• Align stakeholders during implementation and go-live.

• Work with market design, regulation, and business complexity.

• Develop and improve the Market Expansion team’s methods.

I’m looking for someone who is comfortable working in a setting where not everything is predefined. You need to be able to understand the commercial context, ask the right questions and bring the right people together when a new market or product is moving towards go-live.

Lea Vestergaard Klattrup

Manager, Market Expansion

What we are looking for

You have experience from a similar role and understand the practical and commercial considerations involved in entering power and gas markets. You are comfortable working with complexity and with colleagues from different parts of the business.

Must-haves:

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience from a similar position.

• Commercial flair and a good understanding of how trading markets operate.

• Understanding the different aspects involved in entering and implementing new markets.

• Ability to work with market design, regulation, and business complexity.

• Strong project management skills incl. a strong ability to navigate stakeholders on all levels of the organization.

What we offer

You will join a team working directly with NET’s market footprint and have a broad interface with the rest of the company.

• Responsibility for projects that span development, implementation and go-live.

• Collaboration with colleagues across different areas of NET.

• Work across both power and gas markets.

• A mix of new market entries, trading products and lifecycle management.

• The opportunity to help shape the Market Expansion team’s working methods.

Interested?

If the role matches your experience and you are curious about working with market expansion at NET, we would like to hear from you.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Lea Vestergaard Klattrup

Manager, Market Expansion

lvk@norlysenergytrading.com

What makes a product worth bringing to market?

Can you spot the right commercial opportunities, set a clear direction and get the right people moving? In this role, you will work close to both market needs and internal decision-making, with room to influence how product management develops at NET.

The team

You will join the Product Management team in Client Solutions at Norlys Energy Trading (NET) in Aalborg. The team develops and maintains competitive and profitable products that connect clients to energy markets.

The work is closely linked to market-facing teams across the organisation, with a strong focus on relevance, profitability, and speed.

The role

As Senior Product Manager, you will be responsible for selected products and product lines from early scoping through development, launch, performance follow-up and eventual offboarding.

You will define direction, coordinate stakeholders, and keep commercial priorities on track. At the same time, you will contribute to the continued development of NET’s Product Management Method and help strengthen the product management capability across Client Solutions.

Key responsibilities

The role combines commercial judgement, product ownership and coordination across the organisation.

• Define product and product line strategies based on client segment needs and market opportunities.

• Scope and develop new products in line with the internal Product Development and Implementation process.

• Lead launches, implementation, improvements, and offboarding.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders and maintain progress across initiatives.

• Align go-to-market activities with relevant market-facing teams.

• Monitor financial and operational performance and follow up on results.

• Improve the Product Management Method with a focus on agility, profitability and short time to market.

• Participate in selected market events and fairs, with some travel to be expected.

If you like being close to the commercial side of the market, having real ownership and working across all levels of the organisation, this is the role for you. You will also join at a point where there is room to influence how product management is shaped going forward.

Jakob Bro Nielsen

Head of Commercial Solutions

What we are looking for

You are commercially strong, comfortable taking responsibility and used to working across stakeholders to move initiatives forward.

Must-haves

• Proven commercial success from previous roles.

• Experience from energy trading or a closely related industry.

• Experience bringing commercial ideas to the market.

• Strong project management skills and well versed in management of internal stakeholders on all levels of the organisation.

• Relevant educational background, preferably Master’s degree

Additional qualification

• Ability to contribute to the continued development of NET’s product management capability.

What we offer

• Broad responsibility across product direction, development and performance.

• Influence on how product management develops within Client Solutions.

• Close interaction with market-facing teams across the organisation.

• Participation in market events and fairs.

Interested?

If the role sounds relevant to your background, we would like to hear from you. We meet candidates on an ongoing basis.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Jakob Bro Nielsen

Head of Commercial Solutions

jbn@norlysenergytrading.com

_Basware is a global leader in cloud-based purchase-to-pay and e-invoicing solutions, processing billions of transactions annually for enterprise customers across 100+ countries. With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

__We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

_As Portfolio Architect you will own the end-to-end architectural vision for Basware’s product portfolio. You will bridge product strategy, engineering delivery, data and AI innovation — ensuring that our platform evolves coherently, scalably, and with AI-first thinking embedded from the ground up.

You will report into senior technology leadership and work in close partnership with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to set technical direction, govern architectural standards, and accelerate the adoption of LLMs, agentic systems, and ML pipelines across the portfolio.

**What You'll Do

****Architecture Leadership

**

• Define and evolve the portfolio-level technical architecture across Basware’s product suite, ensuring coherence, scalability, and strategic alignment

• Set architectural review processes for AI and set engineering standards that span teams and products

• Identify architectural risk, technical debt, and opportunities for platform consolidation.

**AI/ML Platform Strategy

**

• Lead architectural decisions across LLMs, agentic workflows, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and ML inference infrastructure

• Define the approach for integrating AI capabilities into core product flows — from document intelligence to autonomous process automation

• Evaluate and select AI tooling and frameworks; build the internal knowledge base around responsible experimentation and production readiness.

**MLOps & Governance

**

• Own the MLOps architecture: model training pipelines, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and continuous evaluation

• Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, bias detection, data privacy, and regulatory compliance

• Drive standardised approaches to model lifecycle management across product teams.

**Strategic Partnership

**

• Act as a trusted technical advisor to product leadership, translating architecture decisions into roadmap impact

• Represent Basware’s technical direction in customer-facing conversations, analyst briefings, and partnership discussions

• Mentor and elevate engineering talent across the organisation; establish communities of practice around architecture and AI.

,

**Essential

****What We're Looking For

**

• Proven experience as a Solution, Portfolio or Principal Architect at a $300M+ ARR SaaS company

• Fluent in using with modern AI tooling and integrating them naturally into spec-driven development, architecture design, technical planning, etc

• Demonstrable understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and regulatory considerations (e.g. EU AI Act awareness)

• Strong track record of defining and communicating architectural vision to diverse audiences — engineers, executives, and customers

• Deep cloud-native architecture experience on AWS or Azure

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce crisp, persuasive technical narratives

**Highly Desirable

**

• Domain experience in fintech, accounts payable automation, procurement, or enterprise financial workflows

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture at enterprise scale

• Background in enterprise integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API-first design

• Hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering — specifically in one or more of: LLMs, agentic systems, vector stores, RAG architectures, and ML pipelines

• Practical experience with MLOps tooling and practices (e.g. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent)

• Prior experience contributing to or leading architectural governance bodies (e.g. Tech Council, Architecture Review Board)

**Location & Ways of Working

**This is a remote-first role. We are open to candidates based anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast (broadly UTC−5 to UTC+2). You should expect to travel to key Basware hubs a few times per year for planning cycles, offsites, and customer engagements.

**What We Offer

**

• A high-impact role at the centre of Basware’s AI transformation — with real influence over product direction

• Competitive base salary benchmarked to senior architecture talent in your market, plus performance-linked bonus

• Remote-first flexibility with a strong, distributed engineering culture

• Annual learning & development budget for conferences, certifications, and research

**Why Basware?

**We’re a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you’ll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence.

**Ready to make an impact?

**If you're excited by the challenge, **apply now and help shape the future of Basware.

**Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the ‘I’m interested’ link.

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check.

**Basware. Now it all just happens.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – Shaping BIM, 3D and visualization at Dalux
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux, Innovating the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and we’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape the future of BIM and make complex building information accessible and useful to everyone in construction.

As a Product Manager at Dalux, you’ll operate at the intersection of customer needs, technology, and business strategy. You’ll take ownership of the product roadmap and collaborate closely with Product Design and Development teams to deliver intuitive, high-performing BIM experiences.

You’ll play a key role in evolving how our users view, navigate, understand, and collaborate around building models. Combining an understanding of BIM, UI/UX, and computer graphics, you’ll help turn complex technical capabilities into tools that work effortlessly for our users.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Product Discovery: Evaluate and prioritize new product opportunities, balancing user value, technical feasibility, and business impact.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users to understand their BIM workflows, uncover pain points, and translate feedback into meaningful product improvements.

• User Experience: Collaborate with Product Design to make complex BIM interactions intuitive, from navigating 3D models to finding and understanding building information.

• BIM and Visualization: Work with engineers on model visualization and interaction, balancing visual quality, responsiveness, and performance when handling large and complex building models.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Align with engineers, designers, and fellow product managers to deliver cohesive experiences across Dalux products.

• Feature Ownership: Lead new features from discovery and definition through development, delivery, and validation with users.

• Product Strategy: Help define the direction of BIM at Dalux, identifying opportunities and deciding where we should invest to deliver the greatest value.

**What To Expect As a Daluxian

**At Dalux, we offer a creative, collaborative, and supportive environment where your ideas make an impact. Here’s what you can look forward to as part of our team:

• A central location in Copenhagen, a focus on work/life balance, and no dress code.

• An active social environment with monthly events and social clubs.

• A flat organization with open communication, a short path from idea to product, and the creative freedom and trust to create tangible value for our users.

• A highly specialized, international team with room for creativity and professional growth.

• A strong focus on diversity and inclusion, where your ideas are heard and opportunities are available to all.

• Attractive employee benefits, including health insurance, a lunch plan, coffee and fruit, free fitness facilities, and free parking.

• Support for your professional development and personal well-being.

**About You

**We believe you have a solid background in product management and experience working closely with software development teams, preferably on SaaS platforms. You’re curious about how technology works and motivated by making sophisticated tools easy to use.

We also believe you:

• Have 5+ years of experience in product management, taking products or features from discovery to delivery.

• Have a background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Understand BIM workflows and how building models and their data are used across design, construction, and operations.

• Have a strong understanding of UI/UX principles and can work with designers to evaluate interaction flows, challenge unnecessary complexity, and validate solutions with users.

• Have a working understanding of computer graphics concepts such as 3D geometry, rendering, and model interaction, enabling you to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers.

• Can balance strategic thinking with attention to detail, particularly where usability, model complexity, and performance meet.

• Are comfortable working in agile development environments and prioritizing based on user insights and product outcomes.

• Communicate clearly and fluently in English, both written and spoken.

Experience with IFC, BIM viewers, or other software for working with 3D models would be an advantage.

**Ready for the next step?

**If we have managed to pique your interest, we would love to hear from you. Send us your motivated CV and an application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application today.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics. Despite being the world’s second-largest industry, construction remains one of the least digitalized, with only 30% of onsite time spent on actual building tasks. At Dalux, we’re changing this by providing end-to-end solutions that streamline the entire lifecycle of a building—from design and construction to maintenance and eventual demolition—reducing waste, time, and costs.

We stay ahead by using cutting-edge technology, including cloud solutions, drones, computer vision, and AI, to transform how the construction industry works. Over the last five years, we’ve grown by 60% annually and now have over 700 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

If you’re curious to learn more about Dalux and our products, feel free to visit our LinkedIn or website, where you can find videos and descriptions of our events, products, and the work we do.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

Vilofoss, part of DLG Group, is looking for an experienced Global Quality Manager to lead quality, feed safety and regulatory compliance across our international Animal Nutrition business. Based in Fredericia, Denmark, you will combine a visible, hands-on role in Denmark with leadership of seven quality professionals across six European countries, 12 production sites and external manufacturing partners.

Your main assignment is to bring locally organized quality activities together in one global function. You will establish shared governance, standards, systems and reporting while ensuring that essential local activities remain close to our sites and authorities.

Your responsibilities

• Lead and develop an international team of seven quality professionals across multiple locations.

• Establish the global quality operating model and harmonize the Quality Management System, procedures, KPIs and reporting across Vilofoss.

• Drive feed safety, compliance and continuous improvement across production sites, suppliers and external manufacturing partners.

• Act as the primary contact with Danish authorities and coordinate regulatory requirements across countries, balancing common European standards with local obligations.

• Lead audits, certifications and corrective and preventive actions, including HACCP, GMP+, QS, VLOG and organic standards as examples.

• Partner with Operations, Innovation, Procurement and Supply Chain on product registrations, supplier and raw-material approval, specifications, technical documentation and market compliance.

• Align closely with DLG quality department on quality management systems and common procedures.

What you bring

• Significant senior quality experience from animal nutrition, feed, premix, feed additives, food ingredients or another regulated manufacturing environment.

• Proven international people leadership and experience aligning specialist teams through organizational change.

• Strong knowledge of feed legislation, Quality Management Systems, HACCP, audits and relevant certification schemes.

• Experience working directly with regulatory authorities and translating complex requirements into practical standards for operations.

• Sound judgement and the authority to challenge decisions, hold firm on non-negotiable requirements and act when product safety, compliance or licence to operate is at risk.

• A relevant degree in Animal Nutrition, Food Science, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering or a related field, plus fluency in Danish and English. German is an advantage.

Your opportunity

This is an international leadership role with a clear mandate to build a global quality function and shape how Vilofoss manages quality, feed safety and compliance across countries. You will work closely with operational and business leaders and have direct influence on standards, risk management and performance across the value chain related to quality.

Practical Information

The role is based in Fredericia, Denmark, and requires regular on-site collaboration with Danish operations and authorities. Expect approximately 10–15% travel within Europe.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. For questions about the position, please contact Christine Brøkner, Director, Animal Nutrition, at +45 25 21 77 19.

jobs.occupation: Tilerfor bathrooms and ventilation – we'll train you in diamond drilling
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled tiler who wants more than just tiles in your toolbox? Do you want to learn new skills at a growing company? Then this is the job for you.

Balling Ventilation is based in Stenløse. We work mainly on Zealand and Funen, doing ventilation, radon mitigation and building and renovation work for private and business customers. We are a small company where decisions get made quickly, and we care about good craftsmanship and satisfied customers.

Your tasks

• 
Renovating and building bathrooms: waterproofing, tiling and finishing

• 
General masonry: bricklaying, plastering, repairs and closing up openings

• 
Diamond drilling in masonry and concrete for ventilation ducts (we'll train you)

• 
Installing small ventilation units in private homes (we'll train you)

We expect you to

• 
Have solid experience as a tiler

• 
Be curious and willing to learn diamond drilling and ventilation installation

• 
Work independently, accurately and tidily, including in customers' homes

• 
Hold a valid driver's license (category B)

• 
Speak English 

• 
We offer

• 
A permanent position with varied work, so you're not on your knees tiling all day

• 
Training in diamond drilling and ventilation installation, which gives you new skills

• 
Company van and tools

• 
An informal workplace where you can help shape how things develop

• 
Salary based on qualifications

How to apply
Send a short application, or just a few lines about yourself and your experience, to ze@ballingventilation.dk. We hold interviews on a rolling basis, so apply as soon as possible.

This position is open for candidates located in Warsaw (PL) area or Odense (DK) area.

Are you passionate about quality, GMP compliance, and supporting successful product launches and technology transfers?

At Orifarm, we are looking for a dedicated Quality Assurance Specialist to join our Innovation & Launch team. You will provide QA support across product launches and technology transfers, ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) to secure compliant and efficient implementation of new products and processes.

About the job

As QA Specialist, you will support product launches and technology transfers from a QA perspective. You will provide quality oversight, collaborate across functions and help ensure compliant and timely product supply while balancing quality requirements with business priorities.

Key responsibilities:

• Providing QA support and oversight for product launches and technology transfers.

• Collaborating with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant implementation.

• Ensuring documentation and activities comply with approved procedures, specifications, GMP requirements, and regulatory expectations.

• Reviewing and approving manufacturing documentation, including Master Batch Records and Batch Journals, as part of the broader QA responsibility portfolio.

• Identifying, resolving, and escalating quality and compliance issues when required.

• Participating in change controls, deviations, and risk assessments.

• Driving continuous improvement of QA processes and ways of working.

Who are you?

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where quality, compliance, and business needs must be balanced. You are structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks.

We expect that you:

• Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.

• Have experience from QA/QC, manufacturing, process support, or another GMP-regulated environment.

• Experience with manufacturing documentation is an advantage.

• Have solid knowledge of EU GMP requirements.

• Can work independently and manage multiple priorities.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures.

Who are we?

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative QA organization where professionalism, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are central to how we work.

In Innovation & Launch, we support product launches and technology transfers across Orifarm’s international supply network. We work closely with manufacturing sites, CMOs, project teams, and commercial stakeholders to ensure products reach the market with the right quality and at the right time.

What we offer?

• A key quality role with significant responsibility and impact.

• International collaboration across manufacturing sites and partners.

• A high degree of independence and flexibility.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development.

• Hybrid working model and flexible working hours.

• Attractive compensation and benefits package – details depend on job location.

Job location

Odense (DK) or Warsaw (PL).

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Are you ready to unlock your potential in system engineering at a world leading technology driven company?

We can offer an exciting opportunity where you get to use your technical skills in an innovative environment, with the aim to push the performance of radars to the limit. At Weibel, you will join a global, technology-driven company that develops and produces state-of-the-art radar systems. Our biggest asset is our talented employees, and we believe that by fostering open and curious discussions, we can achieve the best possible solutions.

We are now looking for a new colleague for our Systems Engineering team who wants to be a part of developing our advanced radar systems.

About the position

As a System Engineer in Weibel you will work with requirements and configuration of the overall system. This requires close collaboration with our different engineering departments to ensure that the various sub-systems work together in a manner that fulfills the overall system requirements.

Working at Weibel will provide you with hands-on experience with our radars. You get an understanding of the physics limiting radar performance and potential solutions.

You are a part of the project from the final stages of the sales process until the factory acceptance test with the costumer, where the performance of the finished system is tested based on the predefined requirements.

The position will include tasks such as:

• Drive product definitions and requirements in collaboration with project managers and sub-system engineers.

• Take the technical leadership in a project by bringing people from different departments together, leading internal review meetings etc.

• Participate in internal project meetings and technical meetings with the customer as responsible for system design.

• Assist the project manager to prepare material for design reviews with the customer and to find answers to technical questions.

• Provide technical support to our sales team during project bid-phases.

We do not expect you to have experience with radar systems beforehand, but it is an advantage. You will work in close collaboration with our experienced System Engineers, who have a deep understanding of our systems and you can look forward to a steep learning curve.

You can expect 10-20 travelling days per year.

About our new colleague

You have a university degree within a relevant engineering discipline and you are fluent in English – both spoken and written. You have a few years of experience from a similar organization where you have worked with design, verification and test of complex systems. You have a strong technical foundation and some knowledge of system engineering.

You will play an important role in ensuring that the development of the different sub-systems follow the overall requirements for the system. Therefore, if you are to be successful it is important that you work in a systematic manner and have the ability to keep the overall requirements in mind.

You will work with many difference stakeholders, so it is key that you have good communication skills and the ability to present your results in an effective and structured manner. You take ownership of your own tasks and deliver according to deadlines and the agreed upon quality.

Your new team

You will be joining a team of highly competent and enthusiastic colleagues. The level of experience in the team spans from newly graduated to more than 30 years of experience. Our team members have very different educational backgrounds that varies from electrical, aerospace and mechanical engineering to physics and computer science. We have created it in this way, because we believe that bringing people with different competences together will generate the best solutions.

What we offer

By joining Weibel, you will become part of a professional high-tech company with a dynamic environment who are market leaders in its field. It is a unique opportunity to join the company at an exciting stage.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Engineering Manager, Lina Klintberg, likl@weibel.dk

We will be holding interviews on an ongoing basis during the application period and may close the position before the application deadline. Therefore, please send us your application at your earliest convenience.

The deadline is the 30 November 2026.

Please note that this position requires a criminal record with no remarks and the ability to obtain a security clearance.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of‑the‑art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in‑house production and advanced technological development.

Read more about us on our website.

jobs.occupation: Director, HR Business Partner - Climate Solutions
jobs.description:

**As Director, HR Business Partner at Danfoss Climate Solutions, you will play a key role in shaping the people agenda for our Business Units Industrial Refrigeration and Micro Channel Heat Exchangers. Based out of Denmark and with 2-3 days/week on site in Kolding, you will partner closely with leaders to help drive business performance through people, organization, and culture.

This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on business transformation, organizational effectiveness, and workforce planning. Your ability to connect business priorities with practical people solutions will help leaders navigate change with confidence and clarity.

As a trusted advisor, you will strengthen leadership capability, support sustainable organizational development, and help create an environment where people and teams can thrive in a period of continued growth and evolution.

**

• Partner with business leaders to translate business priorities into effective people strategies that support performance and long-term success.

• Lead and support organizational change initiatives, creating clarity, transparency, and engagement throughout transformation journeys.

• Advise leaders on workforce planning and organizational design to ensure the business has the capabilities needed for future growth.

jobs.occupation: Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist (Construction Sector)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is seeking a proactive and driven Senior Recruiter to support talent acquisition across our fast‑growing European business. This is an exciting opportunity to join a global consultancy with ambitious regional growth plans.

Based in Copenhagen, you will play a key role in attracting and hiring top talent for our Industrial, Science & Technology team in Europe, while supporting recruitment across Data Centre, Life Science and Manufacturing projects in the Nordics.

This is a hands‑on, end‑to‑end recruitment role where you will identify, engage, and hire exceptional project managers, cost managers, and project controls specialists who help deliver world‑class construction projects. You will collaborate closely with the wider European recruitment team, contributing to a high‑performing, fast‑paced environment.

This role would suit an experienced recruitment professional with corporate experience, ideally within a professional services environment, or agency recruiter from a construction background who is looking for more variety and responsibility in a corporate recruitment role within a thriving international consultancy.

Key accountabilities:

• Lead and execute the end-to-end recruitment process for the area of responsibility.

• Responsible for identifying and sourcing active candidates.

• Understand and navigate the local market, promoting market activity and best practices.

• Responsible for ATS (SmartRecruiters) data accuracy and process compliance, from raising requisitions and job posting through to hiring.

• Engage with key programme, country, and regional stakeholders to understand the short-, mid-, and long-term recruitment needs, promoting a positive, proactive response to meeting demand.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and successfully liaise with functions such as HR, Business Operations, Global Mobility, Hiring Managers, and Country MDs to ensure a seamless hiring process.

• Guide candidates through the recruitment process, ensuring a positive candidate experience through proactive communication, timely updates, and professional stakeholder management.

• Act as a trusted recruitment partner, providing market insights and guidance to stakeholders throughout the hiring process.

• Work closely with the wider recruitment team, including coaching, mentoring, and line managing colleagues as agreed.

• Ensure compliance regarding CI and EDI within the European recruitment process.

Qualifications

• Minimum 7 years' experience in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally gained within a corporate/in-house talent acquisition function or a recruitment agency with a strong focus on permanent placements.

• Experience in the construction market recruiting project managers, cost managers, project controls specialists and and other related disciplines.

• Passion for recruiting and finding top talents in a challenging and competitive environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communicator.

• Strong team player who builds positive relationships across functions

• Fluency in English is essential for this role, a Nordic language (Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish) would be considered a strong advantage.

• Highly developed organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Commercial Awareness, with the ability to balance business objectives, project requirements, and market conditions.

Additional Information

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. We also encourage our staff to strive to ‘make a difference’ and become involved in various working committees and forums (for example, Inclusion Working Group, Social & Wellness, Learning & Development, Corporate Social Responsibilities and Net Zero Vision).

At Turner & Townsend we offer a competitive remuneration package and company benefits.

Turner & Townsend value greatly and have a focus on Corporate Responsibilities (CR), this includes a day’s leave entitlement to support a local charity or community activity along with the opportunity to participate in several office events that held throughout the year.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from people from all sectors of the community.

At Spirii, we are building world-class charging products and digital solutions for the future of mobility. Our Digital Development team drives a listen, learn, and lead culture that keeps us improving how we work and how we build.

We are now looking for a Cloud Engineer to join us on this journey. In this role, you will help our engineering teams embrace the DevOps mindset while designing and running our cloud setup. You will be part of building and maintaining a modern, scalable, and secure cloud platform that powers Spirii’s products.

You will report to our Engineering Manager and work closely with colleagues across our Engineering teams, both in-house and near-shore.

**What You Will Be Working On

**

• Build, operate, and improve Spirii’s AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning with CDK for Terraform (CDKTF).

• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling for fast, secure delivery.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to embed platform capabilities and DevOps best practices.

• Ensure security best practices and protect against threats across our cloud setup.

• Monitor infrastructure health and performance using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments.

• Document processes for knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding.

• Contribute to incident management and disaster recovery processes.

**Who You Are

**

• You enjoy working hands-on with cloud infrastructure while enabling others to succeed.

• You bring a DevOps mindset and like to share your knowledge to drive adoption.

• You have a strong sense of ownership and pride in building quality solutions.

• You communicate clearly and collaborate easily across teams.

• You care about developer experience and making platforms easy to use.

• You contribute to an open, friendly, and collaborative team culture.

**What You Bring

****Must-have

**

• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 4+ years in a Cloud/DevOps/Platform Engineer role.

• Strong experience with AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, etc.) and security best practices.

• Kubernetes (EKS) administration and operations.

• Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CDKTF.

• CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions or similar).

• Linux/Unix systems and scripting with TypeScript.

• Monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

• Excellent troubleshooting skills.

**Nice-to-have

**

• Experience with platform development (shared services, APIs).

• Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Knowledge of security architecture for cloud-native applications.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours, and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company, however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
• Assisting the mechanical team if needed
• Helping out the other teams when necessary
Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
• Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
• Availability to pass site tests
• Preferably have offshore experience

Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for both newly graduated candidates with a relevant master’s degree – or equivalent experience – who want to work as IT Consultants at the intersection of technology, business, and people. Do you want to help develop some of Denmark’s most complex and business-critical IT solutions, where software development, project management, and close client collaboration are central parts of everyday work?

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Consultant, you help translate client needs into the right technical solution. We choose the technologies that best fit each project and client. As a result, you should enjoy working across a variety of technologies and domains, while continuously expanding your knowledge and expertise.

A large part of our projects is based on web technologies such as Angular or React, and Java or C# on either a Java or .NET platform. In addition, we work with a wide range of standard platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and others.

As an IT Consultant, you contribute to all parts of system development with a focus on technical tasks. Your responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilites will typically include:

• Setting up and developing frameworks and integrations.

• Implementing features in user interfaces.

• Configuring and developing extensions for standard platforms.

• Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs.

• Developing tools and scripts for migrating large volumes of data.

You will join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise. What we all have in common is a technical mindset and shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together.

Our projects include some of Denmark’s most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you will help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience – most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong technical skills in object-oriented programming.

• Have a solid understanding of software development and motivated to further develop your skills.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Swedish and English (written and spoken) is a must. As you will be working closely with Danish clients and colleagues, you should be able to communicate and collaborate effectively in a Danish work environment.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, influencing multidisciplinary teams, and continuously improving the way engineering is performed - this could be the right opportunity for you.
We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes. We continue to evolve our advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry to deliver real-world solutions that matter to the security of people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for Systems Engineer to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 
Your role as part of the team
As a Systems Engineer within Maritime Projects, you will play a key role in defining technical solutions for some of our advanced defense systems. You will take ownership of technical decisions within assigned system areas while ensuring alignment with the overall system architecture. Throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept and proposal work to development, integration, verification, and customer delivery, you will drive systems engineering activities and help shape the best overall solutions.
In our team, we take pride in developing people and technology. You will become part of a team of 14 System Engineers focused on Maritime projects. As one of the first points of contact for new projects entering the Integrated Product Development department, the team supports project clarification and Sales activities. We work in an informal and collaborative environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and open dialogue are key. We care about the work we do and the people behind it.
Technical skills matter, but your mindset matters even more. If you combine strong technical capabilities with curiosity and a modern systems engineering mindset, you could be a great addition to our team. You thrive when collaborating across disciplines, can simplify complexity and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and know when to focus on details while maintaining a system-level perspective. Most importantly, you are motivated by finding the best solution for the complete system rather than a single discipline.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution
In this role, you will contribute to a range of tasks across your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:
·         Translating customer needs into clear, robust, and achievable technical solutions and identifying technical risks, assumptions, and dependencies early
·         Collaborating across engineering disciplines and stakeholders to ensure integrated system designs
·         Acting as technical owner for one or more system areas, ensuring technical consistency across software, hardware and operational requirements
·         Defining/supporting system architecture, requirements engineering, trade studies, and technical decision-making
·         Contributing to proposal work, engineering estimates, and technical planning
·         Helping improve engineering processes, methods, and collaboration across the organization.
 
Bring your expertise into play
To thrive in this role, we imagine that you bring some of the following qualifications:
